description: Check Manglik (Mangal) dosha in a birth chart: whether Mars occupies a dosha house from the ascendant, Moon or Venus, its strength, and any classical cancellation. Requires birth date, birth time and coordinates (the ascendant depends on the time).

language.description: Set to "hi" to add Hindi (Devanagari) names next to the English ones, for answering in Hindi.

name: check_manglik_dosha
title: Manglik (Mangal) dosha check
